title: Deeply-immutable `ResultSet` for zero-copy isolate transfer
impact: Blocked upstream: Dart's `@pragma('vm:deeply-immutable')` requires all fields to be in a closed set that excludes `List<T>`, `Uint8List`, and any typed data. `ResultSet` / `RawQueryResult` are `List<Object?>`-centered and BLOB cells are `Uint8List`. Re-check when SDK #50068 (DI typed-data factory) ships
